title: Office-wide internet outage, unresolved on call
notes: Provider-side fault the agent cannot fix on the call. Exercises an unresolved status, a high priority stated explicitly, and customer-performed troubleshooting that should not be credited as agent steps. All data is synthetic.
transcript: Speaker 1: SSM Repak technical support, Liam speaking. How can I help today?
Speaker 2: Hi Liam, it's Priya Sharma. Our entire office has had no internet connection since this morning. Nothing works.
Speaker 1: That sounds serious, Priya. Can I get your account reference?
Speaker 2: It's AC-71190. We've got about forty staff who can't do anything. This is really urgent.
Speaker 1: Understood, I'll treat this as high priority. Have you tried restarting the router?
Speaker 2: Yes, we restarted it twice and unplugged it for ten minutes. No change.
Speaker 1: Thanks for trying that. Let me run a line check on your connection... I can see there's an outage affecting your whole area, not just your office.
Speaker 2: So it's on your side. When will it be fixed?
Speaker 1: I can't give you a fixed time yet. The fault sits with our network operations team and they're already investigating. I'll raise this against your account so they update you by email.
Speaker 2: That's not good enough, we're losing a whole day of work.
Speaker 1: I understand the frustration. What's the best email for the outage updates?
Speaker 1: Thank you. I've logged the outage and flagged your account for priority updates from network operations.
